title: The hunt after the battle; strangers carry Gui Li away
summary: Gui Li hides in the mountain forest with his meridians in chaos and his power nearly spent while Qingyun disciples search for him, among them Zeng Shushu and his father Zeng Shucang. Elsewhere Yun Yilan of Fen Xiang Valley corners the wounded Beast Deity and demands the Eight Mystic Fire Formation, saying the Beast Deity promised it for the five clans' sacred artifacts but handed over only three in hundreds of years. Burning, the Beast Deity remembers Ling Long. The Nine-Tailed Fox Xiao Bai steps in; Yun Yilan recognises her as the thief who stole the Mystic Fire Mirror three hundred years ago, and she says she simply dislikes Fen Xiang Valley. Yun Yilan sends word that Fen Xiang will hunt the demons with all its strength. Zeng Shucang catches the injured Gui Li and plans to take him to Qingyun, but strangers who hide their techniques fight him off and carry Gui Li away. Zeng Shucang judges they are not from the Demon Sect. A Small Bamboo Peak senior scolds Lu Xueqi for helping Gui Li, while Gui Li's rescuers chant sutras and use acupuncture to treat wounds left by the Zhu Xian Sword.
